# Shangrila Rénao – The Doll House

> Shangrila Rénao (The Doll House) is a private, entire glass cabin on Tandi hill, Village Bhua, near Jibhi in Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, India. It sleeps up to 4 guests in 2 bedrooms and is rated 4.84/5 from 112 reviews on Airbnb.

## Key facts
- Location: Tandi hill, Village Bhua, near Jibhi, Himachal Pradesh, India
- Capacity: up to 4 guests, 2 bedrooms, 2 beds, 1 bathroom with a tub
- Access: free parking by the lane, then about 70 m on a footpath; arrive in daylight, pack in backpacks; the path can be hard for older guests
- Amenities: valley and mountain views, private hot tub, kitchenette, wifi, dedicated workspace, balcony with bean bags, free parking
- Hosts: Shubhangi and Om, Superhosts on Airbnb
- Rating: 4.84 out of 5, 112 reviews
- Rates, check-in time and cancellation terms depend on dates; confirmed by the hosts. Bookings are completed on Airbnb.
